profile_text.body:
CGI is an IT and business consulting services firm. On its own site the company says it has grown since 1976 into one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world, and it describes a 50-year milestone and a global culture of ownership. It says it consults with leaders on scaling AI through strategy, governance and execution, and it cites work accelerating business intelligence migration planning for a large building materials manufacturer using an AI-enabled assessment.

CGI is a public company traded under the ticker GIB, with a CIK of 0001061574. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for it.
